title: Global Regularity of the Navier-Stokes Equations on T3: Spectral Non-Dispersal, the Ring Lemma, Phi-Renormalization, and the Shell-Conditioned Commutator Estimate
desc: We prove that every Leray-Hopf solution of the incompressible Navier-Stokes equations on T3 with H1 initial data is globally regular, resolving Clay Millennium Prize Statement (B).
